column6: eval (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('table.wikitable tr'); for (const row of rows) { const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td, th'); const text = row.textContent.toLowerCase(); if (text.includes('tungsten')) { return Array.from(cells).map(c => c.textContent.trim()).join(' | '); } } return 'not found'; })()
